Minuscules comme la source. slides.texte_overlay:
uncomfortable things
to do alone to become
unshakeable

go to a museum alone
and stay an hour

no headphones. no rushing.
you'll leave with thoughts
that are actually yours.

train at the busiest hour

everyone is focused
on their own set.
the fear was always louder
than the room.

sit in the front row

at a talk, a class, a meeting.
it feels exposed for
five minutes.
then you hear everything.

send back food that's wrong,
politely

you're not being difficult.
you're being clear.

spend one full evening
with no screen

boredom comes first.
then your own thoughts
come back.

spend five minutes learning
something completely new

not for work. not for anyone.
just to know more today
than you did yesterday.
